Coram : ABHAY MANOHAR SAPRE, S. ABDUL NAZEER
Kerala Abkari (Amended) Act, 1997: ss.8(1) and (2) – Trial court convicted the appellant and sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for six months with a fine amount of Rs. 1 lakh and, in default in payment of fine amount, to undergo simple imprisonment for another period of three months the sentencing by reducing the jail sentence from “six months rigorous imprisonment” to three months simple imprisonment” and in default of payment of fine amount, “three months simple imprisonment” to “two weeks simple imprisonment” – Aggrieved
Decision Date : 25-09-2018 | Case No : CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 1221/2018 | Disposal Nature : Leave granted | Direction Issue : APPEAL PARTLY ALLOWED | Bench : 2 Judges
